subject: Legal Notice - recovery of Rs. 14,20,000/- - Ref RM/CIV/2026/412
body:
To,
The Managing Director,
Nexora
Mumbai

Sub: Notice for payment of outstanding dues for supply of packaging materials

Under instructions from our client, Shree Balaji Packaging Industries, Vapi, we state as follows:

1. Our client supplied corrugated cartons, EPE foam and thermocol inserts to your Mumbai, Pune and Delhi units between March and July 2026 under purchase orders PO/NX/26/077, 094 and 121.
2. Invoices SBP/26/1102, 1187 and 1240 totalling Rs. 14,20,000/- (inclusive of GST) are due and unpaid despite reminders dated 12 August, 7 September and 1 October 2026.
3. Your own email of 22 August 2026 acknowledges the liability.

You are hereby called upon to pay Rs. 14,20,000/- with interest at 12% p.a. from the respective due dates within 30 days of receipt of this notice, failing which our client shall institute civil recovery proceedings before the competent Commercial Court at your risk as to costs and consequences.

Yours faithfully,
Meera Rastogi
Partner, Rastogi & Menon Associates
Fort, Mumbai 400001
T: +91 22 6150 22XX

Sirs,

I represent Mr. Karan Bhalla, who was working as Sales Executive at your Delhi showroom from June 2022 until 12 September 2026, when he was verbally told to leave without any written notice or cause. subject: Notice - complaint of workplace harassment - Ms. Pooja Naik
body:
To the Management, Nexora, Bengaluru Office

My client Ms. Pooja Naik, a Customer Care Executive, submitted a written complaint on 17 August 2026 about repeated inappropriate remarks and pressure by her team lead. Despite the complaint no inquiry has been initiated and your Internal Committee has not contacted her. Since then she has been moved to a night shift without her consent.

My client demands that (1) an inquiry be started immediately in accordance with law, (2) the shift change be withdrawn, and (3) a written response be given within 14 days. Failing this, she will pursue remedies before the competent authority.

Lata Kamat
Advocate, Bengaluru

subject: Notice regarding discrimination in promotion and pay - Ms. Anita Menon
body:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Ms. Anita Menon, Assistant Manager - Accounts at Nexora, Mumbai, who has been in service since April 2019.

Our client has been consistently rated 'exceeds expectations' for the last three appraisal cycles yet was passed over for promotion in July 2026 while less experienced male colleagues were promoted. She also draws a salary approximately 18% lower than colleagues of equal grade and experience. Her written representations of 4 August and 1 September 2026 to the HR head remain unanswered.

Our client seeks (a) a review of her promotion and pay with effect from 1 April 2026, (b) a written explanation of the criteria applied, and (c) an assurance that no retaliatory action will be taken. We require your reply within 30 days of this notice, failing which our client will approach the appropriate forum for relief.

Roshan Fernandes
Partner, Fernandes Legal LLP
Bandra East, Mumbai
+91 22 4008 61XX

Sub: Inspection under the Factories Act, 1948

During the inspection of your assembly unit at Chakan on 14 October 2026 the following contraventions were noted:
1. Machine guards missing on two soldering conveyors.
2. First aid boxes not stocked as per the rules.
3. Overtime registers not maintained for September 2026.
